# TrackMyRupee

> The best personal finance tracker for India. Track expenses, manage budgets, and visualize your spending.

## Overview
TrackMyRupee is a comprehensive financial management tool designed for the Indian market. It provides a precision dashboard and intelligent analysis to turn financial chaos into clarity.

## Key Features
- **Expense & Income Tracking**: Comprehensive logging with category support and bulk actions.
- **Budget Management**: Set and monitor monthly budget limits for different categories.
- **Analytics**: Spending, cashflow and net worth views with comparisons against earlier periods; every chart opens the transactions behind it.
- **Insights**: Calm, specific observations written from your own entries (budgets running out early, categories creeping up, deposits maturing, bills that changed price, goals on track), with the exact numbers behind each. Rule-based, no outside AI service, no comparison with other people. Included on every plan; a weekly insights email is part of Pro.
- **Family sharing**: Up to five people each keep their own account and share only chosen accounts (never transactions). The family sees a combined net worth and who holds which card, policy or loan, with a preview of exactly what is visible, an optional emergency sheet and gentle notes. Needs Pro for every member.
- **Smart Notifications**: Automated reminders for recurring bills, subscriptions, and budget limits.
- **Security First**: Storage-level encryption at rest (managed PostgreSQL on Supabase, Mumbai) and HTTPS in transit, with automated backups. No extra encryption layer inside the app.
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Installable on mobile devices for a native app experience.
- **Multi-lingual Support**: Fully internationalized with support for English, Hindi, and Marathi.

## Who it is for
People in India who want to track expenses, budgets and net worth without giving an app access to their SMS, email or bank login. Transactions are logged manually by typing them like a message (for example "swiggy 320"), with recurring entries automated.

## Facts
- No SMS access, no bank login, no email scanning.
- Budgets follow your salary cycle, not the calendar month.
- Net worth across bank accounts, mutual fund holdings, stocks, FDs, PPF, EPF, NPS and loans.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi. Installable web app (PWA) that works offline.
- Open source. Free plan that does not expire; Plus plan at Rs 49 per month or Rs 499 per year.
- CSV import and export.
